scope: Engine source/public headers, reflection macros, console registrations, config defaults, UBT/UAT commands, and every installed engine plugin descriptor/module. Third-party source bodies are excluded.

value_dictionary.P1: Use the owning module or tool in a compatible UE 5.7.4 process, target, and thread/context.
value_dictionary.R1: The exact declaration, command, setting or schema defines the returned value/result.
value_dictionary.F1: Unsupported platform/target, unavailable owner module, invalid parameter, or engine/tool failure. Preserve diagnostics and restore changed state before retrying.
value_dictionary.S1: Side effects depend on the exact interface; consult its owning module before a state-changing call.
value_dictionary.D1: See the exact UE 5.7.4 declaration and owning implementation for type-specific defaults, units, ranges, and restrictions.
value_dictionary.L1: Use the exact UE patch and respect the interface platform, module and target restrictions.
